dharma.R
content:
# Reimplementation of DHARMa 0.5.0 (simulateResiduals + plot) for glm objects
# (Poisson; binomial with 0/1, cbind(k, m - k) or weights). Equal RNG consumption,
# in the order of plot.DHARMa: residuals (own seed, state restored), KS test,
# outlier test (QQ panel), dispersion test, outlier test (point colours), 3 x qgam.

gp <- function(s, o) min(min(mean(s <= o), mean(s >= o)) * 2, 1)

rk <- function(x) {
  r <- rank(x, ties.method = "average")
  r / max(r)
}

pit <- function(S, y) {
  lo <- unname(rowMeans(S < y))
  up <- unname(rowMeans(S <= y))
  if (any(lo != up)) runif(length(lo), lo, up) else lo
}

obs <- function(m) {
  F <- model.frame(m)
  y <- F[, 1]
  if (is.factor(y)) y <- as.numeric(y) - 1
  if (family(m)$family == "binomial" && "(weights)" %in% colnames(F)) y <- y * F[["(weights)"]]
  if (is.matrix(y)) y <- if (ncol(y) == 1) as.vector(y) else y[, 1]
  y
}

sims <- function(m, B) {
  S <- simulate(m, nsim = B)
  F <- model.frame(m)
  if (family(m)$family == "binomial") {
    if (is.factor(S[[1]])) S <- data.matrix(S) - 1
    if ("(weights)" %in% colnames(F)) S <- S * F[["(weights)"]]
    else if (is.matrix(S[[1]])) S <- as.matrix(S)[, seq(1, 2 * B, by = 2), drop = FALSE]
  }
  if (!is.matrix(S)) S <- data.matrix(S)
  S
}

res <- function(m, y, B, seed) {
  e <- globalenv()
  r0 <- if (exists(".Random.seed", e, inherits = FALSE)) get(".Random.seed", e)
  on.exit(if (is.null(r0)) rm(".Random.seed", envir = e) else assign(".Random.seed", r0, envir = e))
  set.seed(seed)
  if (is.null(r0)) runif(1)
  S <- sims(m, B)
  list(S = S, u = pit(S, y))
}

otest <- function(S, u, nb) {
  n <- nrow(S)
  B <- ncol(S)
  if (n > 500) {
    k <- sum(u < 1 / (B + 1)) + sum(u > 1 - 1 / (B + 1))
    return(binom.test(k, n, p = 1 / (B + 1) * 2)$p.value)
  }
  nb <- min(nb, B)
  o <- mean(u == 0) + mean(u == 1)
  b <- rep(NA, nb)
  for (i in seq_len(nb)) {
    r <- pit(S[, sample(seq_len(B)[-i], size = B, replace = TRUE), drop = FALSE], S[, i])
    b[i] <- mean(r == 1) + mean(r == 0)
  }
  gp(b, o)
}

qtest <- function(u, f, qu) {
  q <- rk(f)
  d <- data.frame(res = u, pred = q)
  g <- data.frame(pred = sort(q))
  k <- min(length(unique(q)), 10)
  nq <- length(qu)
  pq <- rep(NA, nq)
  M <- matrix(NA, nrow(d), 2 * nq)
  for (i in seq_len(nq)) {
    dt <- d
    dt$res <- dt$res - qu[i]
    z <- try(capture.output(fit <- qgam::qgam(res ~ s(pred, k = k), data = dt, qu = qu[i])), silent = TRUE)
    if (!inherits(z, "try-error")) {
      s <- summary(fit)
      pq[i] <- min(p.adjust(c(s$p.table[1, 4], s$s.table[1, 4]), method = "BH"))
      h <- predict(fit, newdata = g, se.fit = TRUE)
      M[, 2 * i - 1] <- h$fit + qu[i]
      M[, 2 * i] <- 1.96 * h$se.fit
    }
  }
  list(q = q, g = g$pred, pq = pq, pqa = min(p.adjust(pq, method = "BH")), M = M)
}

dharma <- function(m, B = 250, nb = 100, qu = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75), seed = 123) {
  y <- obs(m)
  f <- as.vector(predict(m, type = "response"))
  R <- res(m, y, B, seed)
  S <- R$S
  u <- R$u
  ks <- suppressWarnings(ks.test(u, "punif"))$p.value
  o1 <- otest(S, u, nb)
  v <- sd(S)^2
  sp <- function(x) var(x - f) / v
  dp <- gp(apply(S, 2, sp), sp(y))
  o2 <- otest(S, u, nb)
  c(list(y = y, f = f, S = S, u = u, qu = qu,
         p = c(ks = ks, disp = dp, out = o1), out2 = o2),
    qtest(u, f, qu))
}

qqp <- function(r) {
  n <- length(r$u)
  p <- r$p
  plot((1:n) / (n + 1), sort(r$u), pch = 2, las = 1, bty = "n", axes = FALSE,
       xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1), xlab = "Expected", ylab = "Observed",
       panel.first = abline(0, 1, col = "red"))
  sfsmisc::eaxis(1, cex.axis = 0.8)
  sfsmisc::eaxis(2, cex.axis = 0.8)
  fp <- sprintf("%.3f", signif(p, 3))
  text(0.33, 0.9, bquote("KS test: p =" ~ .(fp[1])),
       col = if (p[["ks"]] < 0.05) "red" else "grey50", cex = 0.9, xpd = TRUE)
  text(0.5, 0.5, bquote("Dispersion test: p =" ~ .(fp[2])),
       col = if (p[["disp"]] < 0.05) "red" else "grey50", cex = 0.9, xpd = TRUE)
  text(0.67, 0.1, bquote("Outlier test: p =" ~ .(fp[3])),
       col = if (p[["out"]] < 0.05) "red" else "grey50", cex = 0.9, xpd = TRUE)
  s <- any(p < 0.05)
  mtext("QQ-plot residuals", 3, 1.25, font = 2, cex = par("cex"))
  mtext(if (s) "Significant problems detected" else "No significant problems detected",
        3, 0.25, col = if (s) "red" else "grey50", cex = 0.75 * par("cex"))
}

rvp <- function(r) {
  qu <- r$qu
  o <- r$u == 0 | r$u == 1
  cl <- if (r$out2 < 0.05) ifelse(o, "red", "black") else "black"
  plot(r$q, r$u, pch = ifelse(o, 8, 1), col = cl, las = 1, bty = "n", axes = FALSE,
       xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1), xlab = "Model predictions (rank transformed)", ylab = "",
       panel.first = abline(h = qu, lty = 3, col = "grey75"))
  mtext("DHARMa residual", 2, 3, cex = par("cex"))
  for (i in seq_along(qu)) if (!is.na(r$pq[i])) {
    a <- r$M[, 2 * i - 1]
    b <- r$M[, 2 * i]
    polygon(c(r$g, rev(r$g)), c(a - b, rev(a + b)), border = NA, col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.1))
    lines(r$g, a, col = if (r$pq[i] < 0.05) "red" else "black", lwd = 2, lend = 1)
  }
  sfsmisc::eaxis(1, cex.axis = 0.8)
  sfsmisc::eaxis(2, at = seq(0, 1, 0.25), cex.axis = 0.8)
  if (is.na(r$pqa)) {
    l <- "Some quantile regressions failed"
  } else if (any(r$pq < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    l <- paste0("Quantile deviations detected (red curves)\nCombined adjusted quantile test ",
                if (r$pqa < 0.05) "significant" else "n.s.")
  } else {
    l <- "No significant problems detected"
  }
  s <- l != "No significant problems detected"
  mtext("DHARMa residual vs. predicted", 3, 1.25 + 0.5 * grepl("\n", l), font = 2, cex = par("cex"))
  mtext(l, 3, 0.25, col = if (s) "red" else "grey50", cex = 0.75 * par("cex"))
}

dplot <- function(r, v = FALSE) {
  op <- par(mfrow = if (v) c(2, 1) else c(1, 2), mar = c(5, 4, 3, 2) + 0.1, mgp = c(2, 0.75, 0))
  on.exit(par(op))
  qqp(r)
  rvp(r)
}
